name: Toolathlon
titleZh: 工具十项全能：评测智能体在多样、真实、长程任务上的执行
summary: Diverse apps and tools, realistic environment setup and execution-based scoring, aimed at the long cross-application workflows agents actually face.
summaryZh: 大量应用与工具、真实的环境配置、按执行结果判分，瞄准的是智能体在现实中真正要面对的跨应用长流程。
keyFact: Toolathlon, formally "The Tool Decathlon" (Li et al., arXiv:2510.25726, first posted 2025-10-29, revised 2026-02-26), argues existing agent benchmarks are too narrow and scores agents on cross-application long-horizon workflows by execution rather than by matching text.
keyFactZh: Toolathlon，正式标题为 "The Tool Decathlon"（Li 等，arXiv:2510.25726，2025-10-29 首次提交，2026-02-26 修订）指出既有智能体基准过于狭窄，改按执行结果而非文本比对来评测跨应用的长程工作流。
whyItMatters: The shift worth noting is scoring the whole workflow rather than a single tool call, which is where real deployments break.
whyItMattersZh: 值得注意的转变是：按整个工作流判分，而不是单次工具调用——真实部署恰恰是在这里崩掉的。
title: The Tool Decathlon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Diverse, Realistic, and Long-Horizon Task Execution
